$comment: What: JSON Schema of an environment file config/environments/<env>.json (plan §3.1): where the services, Kafka, Postgres, k6 and monitoring are, and the safety switches. How: documentation and editor help; tools/core/environment.mjs validates the same rules by hand (validateEnvironment) when an environment is loaded. Needs: nothing. Outputs: nothing; there is deliberately no 'prod' kind, and any name matching /prod/i is refused by every command.
title: CCE performance tests environment

services.description: Direct service URLs (never the gateway). Keys: collector, matcher, stepSla, protocol (subject step-sla maps to stepSla).

passwordEnvVar.description: Name of the environment variable holding the password; never the password itself.

dockerNetwork.description: 'host' on a laptop; any other Docker network publishes the k6 REST API port on 127.0.0.1.

settings.description: Environment-specific setting defaults, same names as config/settings/defaults.json.

adaptors.description: Reserved for later adaptor modules (plan §10.4); no in-scope code reads it.

pollIntervalSeconds.description: Step SLA only: the service's scheduler poll interval in seconds (CCE_SLA_POLL_INTERVAL_MS / 1000). Default profile 5 (application.yml, used by local-stack); prod profile 15 (application-prod.yml, used by deploy-scripts). Drives the preflight step-sla-scheduler wait (value + 2 s) and STEP_SLA_MAX_WAIT=auto (2 x value).
